main_comparison.scope: Existing batch numerical audits plus current hashes of original results, traces, candidates, point clouds, protocols, sources and exported reports. No physical replay.

main_comparison_note: The existing full evidence audit is retained through its source hash; this release performs fresh aggregation and completeness checks, not a new physics replay.

source_ablation.scope: Current hashes of existing numerical-audit result/trace records, calibration records, and outcome plan/candidate/perception receipts. No physical replay and no new experiments.

source_ablation_scope: Exploratory extension; 2784 new outcomes and 2784 reused main-comparison outcomes. Reused outcomes must not be counted as new independent runs.
raw_assets_note: Original result reports, simulation traces, candidate archives, point clouds, synthetic images and downloaded weights/CAD are excluded. IDs and hashes identify the retained evidence; the released code and pinned inputs support regeneration. Exact bitwise simulation reproduction is not guaranteed.
